title: Concurrent RMW lock stress intermittently reports unsafe owner metadata
observation: The intermittent Node 22 stale .rmw-lock stress failure seen on the v1.41.4 release CI (a writer threw reading .hunch/edges/.rmw-lock/owner.tmp.json through readRmwOwner) was a release+re-acquire race during the owner read. Fixed by #420 (4660473): readRmwOwner re-reads the owner after that race, with a regression test (aa691b1); shipped in v1.42.0. The issue #293 takeover race and PID reuse were fixed earlier by a91b400 (an exclusive .reclaim claim, and recycled PIDs detected by process identity).
